scripts.build:development: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode development
scripts.build:staging: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode staging
scripts.build:production: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode production
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build:development && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:staging && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --branch staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --branch main
